scope: Refined QMIX v4 training and selection interpretation only
reason: Optimizer.load_state_dict restored the Extended checkpoint learning rate after the Refined optimizer was constructed.
consequence: v4 is not evidence about a low-learning-rate refinement. Its selection metrics describe a same-rate warm-start candidate that was rejected.
remediation: The loader now reapplies the configured LR after optimizer-state restore and future training verifies the LR serialized in the selected checkpoint. A corrected experiment requires fresh selection seeds.
